source.title: Vicenzo Guerino Cecchini wins WCA South American Championship 2018, in Poá, São Paulo, Brazil
source.content:
[Vicenzo Guerino Cecchini](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015CECC01) won the [WCA South American Championship 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018) with an average of 7.74 seconds. [Iuri Grangeiro Carvalho](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015CARV06) finished second (8.52) and [Juan Pablo Huanqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013HUAN30) finished third (8.62).

South American records: Antonio Gabriel Freitas da Silva‎ 3x3x3 Cube 5.58 (single).

translation.title: Vicenzo Guerino Cecchini 夺得巴西圣保罗州波阿 2018 年 WCA 南美洲锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Vicenzo Guerino Cecchini](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015CECC01) 以 7.74 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2018 年 WCA 南美洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018)冠军。[Iuri Grangeiro Carvalho](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015CARV06) 以 8.52 秒获得亚军，[Juan Pablo Huanqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2013HUAN30) 以 8.62 秒获得季军。

南美洲纪录：Antonio Gabriel Freitas da Silva，三阶单次 5.58 秒。
